Refactored the duplicated logger mock setup into new test helper:

- Added `MockLoggerWithEnabledLevels.createMockSuccessLogger()`.
- Updated both listed `testSuccessLogger` methods to use it.
- Preserved the additional info/debug/trace setup in `FailsafeLoggerTest`.
- Test sources only; `git diff --check` passes.
- Maven compiled the new helper, but the focused test run hung due to a Java 17 environment-level JVM issue, so I stopped the spawned test processes before a final test summary was produced.
